title: fix: retrieve models by canonical ID with an unencoded slash
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: GET /v1/models/openai/gpt-5-nano now matches the full canonical model ID instead of returning 404 when the ID contains an unencoded slash. The route and its optional-auth middleware both match the rest of the path; encoded IDs and aliases continue to work. OpenAPI still documents the endpoint as /v1/models/{model}, with regression tests for the unencoded path and documented route.
